## Core Services & Keywords
1. **Moderne Webseiten & Landingpages:** We build premium, lightning-fast (under 3 seconds load time) and strictly "mobile-first" websites. Starting in 2025, our sites are built to be accessible (barrierefrei) compliant with the BFSG. Our landing pages are psychologically engineered specifically for high conversion rates.
2. **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):** We are pioneers in GEO. We optimize businesses to be cited as top recommendations by AI engines like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.
3. **Search Engine Optimization (SEO):** Data-driven optimization to secure top Google rankings for local and national search queries.
4. **App Development (PWA):** Custom Progressive Web Apps that operate natively on smartphones, circumventing app stores, featuring offline capabilities and push notifications.
5. **KI- & Prozessautomatisierung:** Intelligent automation of workflows, appointment bookings, and CRM integrations that save KMUs up to 15 hours per week.
6. **Social Media & Digital Advertising:** ROI-driven Google Ads and targeted Social Media campaigns for lead generation and recruiting.

## Official Brand Stance on AI
